title: Feature flags
description: Feature flags. Back-end settings that must be fetched and changed by Benchling.

Visibility.description: Optional. Who can see this feature flag in Benchling (e.g. CUSTOMER, INTERNAL_ADMIN). Informational; recorded by an export, not something you set.

Editability.description: Optional. Who can change this feature flag's value (e.g. INTERNAL_ADMIN, INTERNAL_ADMIN_WITH_APPROVAL). Informational; recorded by an export, not something you set.
